items.title: Invest $100,000 in These 4 Dividend Stocks and Collect Passive Income for Life
items.summary: Selling shares in a down market to cover groceries is the retirement mistake planners fear most. Four blue-chip payers, including one that sends checks monthly, offer a way to keep the shares and still get paid.

items.title: If You Can Only Buy One High-Yield Dividend Stock Forever, Make It This One
items.summary: A monthly paycheck that has grown for decades sounds like a dream for retirees, but one rising cost could test it next year. Here is what makes this REIT's payout so durable and the pressure point worth watching.

items.title: KKR Stock And Blue Owl Shares In Focus As Credit Tightens
items.summary: Credit is getting tighter, refinancing is getting tougher, and suddenly the cost of money really matters again. That shift puts pressure on weaker borrowers but also shines a spotlight on listed private credit and short duration bond vehicles that sit closer to the flow of income. For investors who care about steady coupons and balance sheet resilience, the ripples from this credit crunch could be a rare opening.
